collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: The whole village pauses as the sky turns orange over the sea.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: The whole village pauses as the sky turns orange over the sea. For a moment, even the busiest workers stand still.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: The whole village pauses as the sky turns orange over the sea. Someone sighs, and several people laugh because they were about to do the same.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: The whole village pauses as the sky turns orange over the sea. A child asks if the sun is going to sleep, and an elder says, "Something like that."

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: The whole village pauses as the sky turns orange over the sea. The colors fade slowly, and work resumes with a little more cheer.
